intro: Tucson's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $100/month, down 4.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $110. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city, and Storage Stats has no market page for it, so that StorageCafe figure is the advertised rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $41 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$48.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $60 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$67. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $100, down 4.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Storage Stats does not publish a market page for this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$110.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $133 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$142.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $165 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$184.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Broadway Northeast (~$80), Alvernon Heights (~$83), Sunnyside (~$85) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. El Presidio (~$213) is among the highest.
Tucson has about 135 facilities and 9.0 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 96,615 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026 (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
